text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest (5 Oct 2025, teams/team-north/digests). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at the Eau Claire yard gatehouse, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting their bay texts. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's 04:00 shift got through without help.
2. **#4419**, from Moss's "North cheat sheet," which has no date (teams/team-north/digests). Thea opened it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

Things to watch for in the weekly notes:
- These two may not be separate problems. Both are at the gatehouse and Door 14, and the cheat sheet has no date. I can't tell from the notes, so it's worth checking the ticket system before you write them up as two issues.
- Moss's 14 Sep 2025 North digest and 23 Mar 2026 renewal note both cover Quarrendon, but neither has a ticket number.
- Ticket numbers #4409 and #4412 (plus a feature request, FR-882) show up in Moss's Central notes, but they belong to Central accounts, not Quarrendon. Leave them out.
- Marcus has a note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one r), a different company that isn't a customer. It has no tickets, so don't mix the two up.

I only looked at Moss's notes you can open yourself, and I didn't find any other Moss notes.
